doc: Coordination among tabs, windows, frames and workers of one application (LCP-040), without shared mutable state: each context's engine keeps its own state, and only JSON messages cross. Channels are same-origin broadcast (BroadcastChannel, or a SharedWorker hub the host serves); frame messaging is point-to-point with one exact origin, never a wildcard, and accepts only messages from that frame at that origin. Every message is size-bounded and checked as JSON before an engine sees it; the engine decodes its own schema. Web Locks are coordination mechanics: holding one means only that no other context holds it; what that means (a leader, a writer) is the engine's. A context that disappears releases its locks, so the next contender acquires.

types.name: ContextId
types.doc: This page instance, issued at random by the pack; how other contexts tell messages apart.

types.name: LockHandle
types.doc: Opaque; issued by this page's pack.

types.name: PeerId
types.doc: Opaque; a frame or parent this page listens to.

types.name: Via
types.doc: broadcast: BroadcastChannel. hub: a SharedWorker relay the host serves.

types.name: RefusedReason
types.doc: wrong-origin: the sender's origin is not the declared one. wrong-source: right origin, but not the declared frame. not-json: the message was not bounded JSON.

variants.name: frame
variants.doc: An iframe named in HTML by data-frame-target.

variants.name: parent
variants.doc: The page this document is framed in.

variants.name: broadcast
variants.doc: To every other context with the channel open; never back to this one.

variants.name: acquire
variants.doc: wait false answers Busy at once if another context holds it; steal takes it from the holder, which hears LockLost.

variants.name: listen
variants.doc: origin must be an exact origin (scheme, host, port); no wildcard, no opaque origin.

variants.name: TooLarge
variants.doc: The serialized message is longer than limit characters.

variants.name: PeerGone
variants.doc: The frame was removed, or navigated away from the declared origin.

variants.name: Undeliverable
variants.doc: Something arrived on the channel that the pack will not pass on.

variants.name: LockLost
variants.doc: Another context stole the lock; this context no longer holds it.

variants.name: PeerRefused
variants.doc: A message that was not delivered; origin is what the browser reported.
